translations.web: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice. Righteousness lodged in her, but now there are murderers.
translations.bsb: See how the faithful city has become a harlot! She once was full of justice; righteousness resided within her, but now only murderers!
translations.kjv: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
translations.asv: How is the faithful city become a harlot! she that was full of justice! righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers.
